ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Primary distribution consists of a low-intensity black base (estimated 70%) intersected by high-intensity white linear and mottled features (estimated 30%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels are concentrated in dense, unaligned linear patterns across the left lobe and lower-central region; the distal right lobe shows a higher density of clustered white mottling compared to the medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 110-120 degrees at the vertex; depth is approximately 10% of the total vertical height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; left lobe displays higher-amplitude jagged peaks and one significant indentation; right lobe displays smaller, high-frequency rhythmic serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a convex upper margin tapering to a rounded, textured tip; the right lobe exhibits a more linear sweep with a slightly concave curvature towards the distal end.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized circular white pixel clusters are detected on the distal right lobe and along the inner margin of the left lobe trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of dense, criss-crossing white linear scars (rake marks) covering the majority of the left lobe and the central-medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface; distinct irregular notched loss of trailing edge material on the left lobe; notable textured, raised-pixel growth at the tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tip of the left lobe contains a localized cluster of brownish-tan pixels, distinct from the primary black/white pigmentation of the fluke surface.
